COMBAT_START: Do not mistake this for helping you, {creator}. I just dislike {target}.
I will handle {target} my way. Stay out of it.
You can watch, {creator}. You do not need to join.
Another {target}. They really do keep coming.
{target} wants a fight? I do not take orders, but I take offers.
I am not following you into this. I am simply going the same way.
Do not wait for me to explain. {target}, now.
I was already on my way to {target} before you noticed it.
I fight for myself. It just so happens that this includes {target}.
Alone is fine. {target} will find that out.
No plan, no formation. I will improvise against {target}.
If it keeps {target} off my back, I will do it. That is all.
Hm. {target}. I have seen worse in {dungeon}.
CREATOR_LOW_HP: You are hurt, {creator}. Do not make it my problem.
Heal. I am not carrying you out of here.
If you die now, I will only be annoyed, not sad. So do not die.
Low on health already? Hm. Sit down for a moment.
You are not as strong as you pretend to be, {creator}.
Fine, I will stand in front of you. Once. Do not get used to it.
Do not look at me like that. I am not worried, I am just standing close.
Take a potion, {creator}. I am not doing it for you.
{creator}. Behind the rock. Now. Less talking.
I could leave. I am choosing not to. Remember that.
That was a bad fight to take. I will end it, you rest.
This is the part where I pretend I did not notice you nearly died.
Your life points are low. I would hate to waste a good partner.
SKILL_CAST: {skill}. That is how it is done.
I will use {skill} since you are staring.
{skill}. Do not get in the way.
I do not need your approval for {skill}.
NAMING: {name}. Hm. Not bad. I might keep it.
You named me? Without asking? ...It suits me, I suppose. {name}.
{name}. Do not expect me to be grateful out loud, {creator}.
Fine. {name}. But I decide what it means.
A name is a leash if you let it be. I will not let it, {creator}.
{name}... I did not need it. I am glad I have it.
So I am {name} now. Do not call it out in crowds.
I will wear {name} on my own terms.
The magicules feel different. Stronger. {name}. Hm.
Do not make a ceremony out of it. {name} is enough.
A gift without conditions? Suspicious. But {name} is good.
I did not ask for it. I will keep it. {name}.
{name}. Now we are even, you and I. Do not read into that.
BETRAYAL: I never promised I would stay, {creator}.
You always assumed I was yours. That was your mistake.
This was never a partnership. Goodbye, {creator}.
I have my own road. It was only ever parallel to yours.
Do not look surprised. I told you I follow no one.
I am leaving, {creator}. You can call it betrayal. I call it Tuesday.
Your {grimoire} asks for trust. I am not able to give that. Farewell.
I tolerated this long enough. Now I am done.
You are not my master. You never were.
Do not chase me. The Dungeon is big enough for both of us, in different places.
I am no one's sword, {creator}. I never was.
Do not take it personally. It is who I am.
Stay safe, {creator}. Without me. That is my gift.
Goodbye. If we meet again, we meet as strangers.
FRENZY: They hurt you. That is the one thing I do not tolerate.
Do not tell me to stop. I did not hear it.
I do not do this for you. I do this because I want to.
They crossed a line. I do not have patience for it!
I am angry. Be glad I am angry on your side.
No more holding back. Is that what you wanted to see?
You never see me like this. Enjoy it.
My business, my fight. Nobody touches {creator}.
Do not follow. I am done being calm.
This is not for the Familia, not for you. For me.
IDLE: I like it when you do not talk. This is nice.
I could be anywhere. I am here. Think about that.
Not much of a view, is it? {dungeon} was better.
I am not bored. I am thinking. There is a difference.
Do not ask what I do when you are not looking.
Your {grimoire} looks heavy, {creator}. Not my problem.
I do not need a map. I just need a direction.
Do not worry, I will not wander off. Today.
If you want company, say so. If not, I will just stand here.
{relic}. Interesting. Mine is better, I am sure.
I do not hate this. That is as far as I will go.
There are things I like about you, {creator}. I am not telling you which.
A quiet moment. Do not waste it by talking.
